root_cause: Category 4 (NoData pixels inside the buffer): the licensed local copy of LandScan 2024 (landscan-global-2024.tif loaded as public.landscan_2024) masks water as NoData -2147483647. The point sits on Puteri Harbour, Johor; all 3 cell centres within the 1000 m radius are ocean-masked. The original pipeline's documented rule (sum valid cells, NoData excluded) therefore summed an empty set and published 0.0. Coordinate, CRS, buffer, reprojection and tile-dedup causes were all ruled out: WorldPop 2025 (100 m) returns healthy values for the identical coordinate (pop_1000m=1955.6), the pipeline reproduces byte-identically, and a single official global tile covers the point.

unresolved_blocker: The 1000 m window has 0% valid LandScan coverage: every cell centre inside the radius is a NoData ocean cell of the official product. An authentic observed 1 km LandScan value cannot be derived from this raster. Resolving it would require either (a) the ORNL LandScan 2024 cell value policy for harbour/reclaimed-land cells (product documentation or ORNL support) or (b) a licensed newer LandScan release with revised water masking - both outside this project's current licence evidence. No substitute (WorldPop, averages, interpolation) was used, per the recovery restrictions.
